components.note: 忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — feelings and mind: 怕 afraid, 情 emotion, 快 happy; 怖 is terror.
布 (bù) sounds exactly like 怖; also in 部 bù.
酉 (wine jar) — fermented drinks and flavors: 醉 drunk, 醒 sober, 酸 sour, 配 match; 酒 is liquor, with 氵 for the liquid.
酉 also hints at the sound: yǒu is close to jiǔ.
口 (mouth) — speech sounds and particles: 吗, 呢, 啊; 吧 is a suggestion particle, or the bar in 酒吧.
巴 (bā) sounds exactly like 吧; also in 爸 bà, 把 bǎ, 爬 pá.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — talking and discussion: 说, 议, 谈; 论 is debate and theory.
仑 (lún) gives the sound; same part in 轮 lún and 伦 lún.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 份 is a person's portion or share.
分 (fēn) is a near sound match for fèn; also 粉 fěn and 纷 fēn.
木 (wood) — trees and wooden things: 树, 板, 样; 模 was a wooden mold or pattern.
莫 (mò) is close to mó; same part in 摸 mō, 膜 mó, 墓 mù.
足 (foot) — a kneecap 口 above a foot 止; as the radical ⻊ it marks feet and walking: 跑, 跳, 路, 踢. Also means enough.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; here the word for still or again.
乃 (nǎi) is a loose sound hint; 扔 rēng shares the same part.
一 (horizon) — the sun 日 just rising above the ground line: dawn. 旦 also sounds out 担 dān, 但 dàn and 胆 dǎn.
口 (mouth) — tasting and speaking: 吃, 喝, 嗅; 味 is flavor.
未 (wèi) sounds exactly like 味; also 妹 mèi.
三 — three strokes, one more than 二. The numbers 一 二 三 are the only ones counted by drawing lines.
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — feelings and mind: 怕, 情, 快; 怀 is to cherish something in the heart or bosom.
不 (bù) only stands in for the complicated sound part of traditional 懷 (huái); a loose clue.
尸 (a sitting person, body) — a figure at rest or a building: 屋 house, 层 floor, 尾 tail; 居 is to dwell.
古 (gǔ) is a loose clue; 居 jū sounds out 据 jù, 剧 jù and 锯 jù.
扌 (hand radical, 提手旁) — actions by hand: 打, 推, 抱; 拒 is to push back or refuse.
巨 (jù) sounds exactly like 拒; also in 距 jù.
贝 (cowry shell, money) — wealth and trade: 财, 费, 买, 货; 员 was a paid member or staff. 员 also sounds out 圆 yuán.
交 (cross, hand over) — a person with legs crossed: to intersect, then to exchange. Same part in 校 xiào, 较 jiào, 胶 jiāo.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位; 停 is a person stopping.
亭 (tíng) sounds exactly like 停; same part in 婷 tíng.
心 (heart) — feelings: 想, 思, 感, 怕; 恶 is a bad heart, evil.
亚 (yà) is only a loose sound hint for è.
女 (woman) — a family of female words: 妈, 姐, 妹; 婊 is a vulgar term.
表 (biǎo) sounds exactly like 婊.
尸 (body, building) — dwelling and body words: 居, 屋, 层; 属 is to belong to a family or group.
Traditional 屬 had 蜀 (shǔ) as sound part, also in 独 dú, 烛 zhú, 触 chù; simplified 属 keeps the reading shǔ.
⻊ (foot, form of 足) — feet and stepping: 跑, 跳, 踢; 蹈 is to tread or stamp.
舀 (yǎo) is a loose clue; same part in 稻 dào and 滔 tāo.
几 (small table) — a low table with legs. As a sound it gives jī to 机 and 肌, and means how many in 几个.
夕 (evening, night) — night and time: 外, 多, 夜; dreams come at night, so 夕 is the meaning clue; 林 is only filler.
旡 (turned-away person) — someone turning from the food 皀 after eating: already done. Compare 即, who is just about to eat.
艹 (grass, plants) — plants and flowers: 花, 草, 茶; 英 first meant a flower, then outstanding, then hero.
央 (yāng) is a loose sound hint (-ng); also in 映 yìng and 殃 yāng.
隹 (short-tailed bird) — birds: 集, 难, 雀; 雄 male and 雌 female were first words for birds of each sex.
厷 (gōng) is a loose sound clue for xióng.
土 (earth) — two people 从 sitting on the ground 土: to sit. Also in 座 zuò seat.
亻 (person radical, 单人旁) — people and what they do: 你, 他, 位.
牛 (ox) — in the traditional reading, a person 亻 dividing up an ox: one piece, hence 件 as a measure word for items.
辶 (walk, 走之旁) — movement and roads: 过, 进, 送; 适 is to go to what suits you. 舌 is a simplification stand-in, not a real clue.
宀 (roof) — houses and shelter: 家, 安, 室, 字; 寓 is a place of residence.
禺 (yù) sounds the same; also 遇 yù and 愚 yú.
文 (writing, culture) — a person with a patterned chest, early tattooed designs, which became writing and culture. Also in 纹 wén and 蚊 wén.
寸 (inch, hand) — measuring and hands: 对, 导, 寺; 寻 traditionally meant stretching arms to measure, then searching.
攵 (tap, hand with stick) — actions of striking or acting: 教, 放, 改, 政; 攻 is to attack.
工 (gōng) sounds exactly like 攻; also in 功 gōng, 红 hóng, 空 kōng.
辶 (walk, 走之旁) — movement: 过, 进, 送, 迎 welcome; 邀 is to go out to meet and invite.
敫 (jiǎo) is the sound part, only a loose clue for yāo.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — talking and asking: 说, 谢, 谈; 请 is to ask politely.
青 (qīng) sounds like 请 (tone differs); same part in 清, 情, 晴, 精, 静.
氵 (water radical, 三点水) — water and waves: 河, 海, 汤; 浪 is a wave.
良 (liáng) is a loose clue; also in 狼 láng, 朗 lǎng and 娘 niáng.
贝 (cowry shell, money) — money and trade: 财, 货, 买, 贵; 费 is a cost or fee.
弗 (fú) is close to fèi; same part in 沸 fèi.
半 (half) — 牛 (an ox) divided in two by 八: half. Seen in 一半 half, 半夜 midnight.
木 (tree) — 某 first named a sour tree fruit; now it means a certain, unnamed one. It sounds out 媒 méi, 煤 méi and 谋 móu.
囗 (enclosure) — boundaries and surroundings: 国 country, 园 garden, 回 return; 图 is a drawn plan of a region.
又 (hand) — a hand pushing against a cliff 厂: turning back, opposite. Sound series: 饭 fàn, 板 bǎn, 版 bǎn, 返 fǎn.
予 (yǔ, give) is only a loose sound hint for shū; compare 序 xù and 预 yù.
